Author: WayneXXDD
Name: Guildhest Queue (Wayne, Testing)
Punchline: Repeat guildhests while you handle the combat.
Description: Global client: select a guildhest or Guildhests roulette, automatically queue, confirm entry, and leave after completion before repeating. Optional short forward movement once per entry after character control becomes available. Combat remains manual or handled by your other plugins. Standalone: no CBT, Yes Already, AutoDuty or navigation plugin required. Open /ghq.
Changelog: 0.1.1.0: Add optional forward movement once per entry after Duty Start and character control are available. Adjustable ready delay and movement duration. Stop movement on timeout, combat, casting, manual cancellation, loop stop, completion or unload; do not take over existing auto-run.
